description: Use Yournotify to find and create contacts, review audiences, check wallet balance, create Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Voice, Push and In-app campaigns, and inspect campaign performance. Manage Calls drafts, history and analytics, and open a live dialler in supported clients. Voice supports text-to-speech and hosted audio. Calls uses your microphone after you review the recipient and pricing and choose Make call; unsupported clients can open the same call in Yournotify. Scheduling or sending a campaign requires explicit confirmation.

defaultPrompt: Show my recent campaigns and their performance.
List my audience lists and recent contacts.
Show my approved Voice and Calls numbers and open the Calls dialler without starting a call.
